title: Luminous sweep spreadsheet reveal
blurb: A live HTML spreadsheet inside one ElementGL WebGL 2 canvas. An upward band of blurred, refracted light sweeps across an empty skeleton grid or pre-sort FBO snapshot to reveal editable cells, clickable sort headers and recalculated totals.
question: When a live HTML <table> spreadsheet populates from an empty skeleton or reorders on a sort, can one ElementGL WebGL 2 canvas sweep an upward band of blurred refracted light across the cells while keeping inputs, sort buttons and totals live right behind the wavefront?
result: Not verified in a live browser yet. Built on one ElementGL WebGL 2 context with a grid-aligned skeleton shimmer above the wavefront, offscreen FBO snapshot capture for column sorts and clears, chromatic blur refraction across the light band, updateElementGeometry() hit-box calibration, a 5-argument drawElementImage() 2D fallback and plain-HTML context-loss recovery.
